office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders in King County District Court for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: attorney and longtime pro tem judge Mitch Greene is the only candidate; no sitting judge is on the ballot for this seat.

candidates.summary: Attorney since 1992 and pro tem judge since 1997 who says he has handled thousands of misdemeanor, gross misdemeanor, and infraction cases.
highlights: Practicing attorney since 1992; pro tempore judge since 1997 [S1]
Says he has presided over thousands of hearings [S1]
Not a sitting elected judge; no incumbent appears on the ballot for this seat [S1]
